name: Got to School
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Give the mother the black coat. Shine the flashlight at her face.
Use the boxing gloves to wake her.
Blow the megaphone beside her ear.
Open the window and bring in the rooster.
Pour the bucket of ice water on her.
Release the gas from the container.
Tickle her feet with the feather.
Give the microphone to the Shiba dog and let it bark loudly.
